posts.title: A Gathering of Weird Little Freaks
posts.description: Alt Text: Illustrated poster for the tabletop gaming convention Between Two Cons, held at Norse Hall in Portland, Oregon, June 26–27, 2026. Two enormous moss-covered stone heads with red gem eyes flank the title, while a small skeleton lies on a rune-carved altar above a flaming brazier and stone steps. What can I say? This was, hands down, the best con experience of my short con going career. Eve

posts.title: A CON-tender for My Fave Con: Part One
posts.description: Alt text: A crowded indie RPG convention hall: attendees with red lanyards chat and work at tables strewn with colorful index cards, while vendor tables of zines sit beneath “Cairn” and “ARCANE” banners. Photo by Yochai Gal Thursday This was my first time at two things: Arcane Con and a con without my better half and boss, Megan. I missed Megan while there and now miss Massachusetts and Arcane Con

posts.title: The Revisions, Part I
posts.description: ALT TEXT: A cluttered desk with notepads, scattered papers, and pens. Stacks of colorful books and a dark green journal labeled "Notes" add a scholarly ambiance. It has begun. I am currently doing revisions on a project of love. Above is a snapshot of my analog workspace. The two closest journals to the lens are my daily writing journals.
